name: Water Sapta

angles.text: A sapta is an alchemical or ritual draught used by shamans to attune their spiritual senses to elemental spirits that remain invisible to ordinary sight.
Investigating corrupted waters within Westfall brings elemental cleansing rites into the heart of an Alliance realm.

faq.answer: A water sapta is a specialized spiritual brew created for shamans to commune with the elements. Drinking or using a sapta temporarily opens one's perception to elemental entities and spiritual imbalances that are otherwise hidden from mortal eyes.

The tainted pond water is located within the lands of Westfall. Shamans are directed there while holding the water sapta to locate corrupted water sources and address whatever spiritual disturbance festers within the region.
faq.q: Where is the tainted pond in Westfall?

faq.answer: Even in agrarian and drought-stricken human lands like Westfall, elemental waters can fall prey to pollution or dark corruptions. The quest tasks you with seeking out tainted pond water to investigate and restore balance to the troubled spirits residing there.
faq.q: Why does the water sapta lead to Westfall?

faq.answer: Water saptas are entrusted to shamans undergoing trials of elemental communion. By partaking in the sapta, the practitioner attunes their senses to water spirits, allowing them to perceive hidden elementals or inspect tainted pools.
Upon using the water sapta near the tainted pond in Westfall, elemental sight is granted, revealing the spiritual state of the water or summoning hidden spirits tied to the local water trial.
faq.q: What happens when you bring the sapta to the tainted pond?

faq.answer: Saptas combine earthy reagents and elemental blessings into a ceremonial draught. Shamans rely on them during their trials to attune to specific elements—earth, fire, water, or air—bridging the gap between the physical world and the spirit realm.
faq.q: How do elemental saptas work in shamanic tradition?

sections.body: In the elemental traditions of shamans, a sapta is a ceremonial concoction prepared to pierce the veil between the physical realm and the spirits. The Water Sapta attunes the senses specifically to the element of water, granting the spiritual vision necessary to perceive elemental disturbances and hidden spirits. Without such an attunement, ordinary travelers could look directly upon an elemental manifestation and see nothing more than ordinary ripples.
sections.title: The Sight of the Waters

sections.body: The directive behind the Water Sapta sends the bearer to Westfall, an arid Alliance realm troubled by unrest and neglect. Within this windswept land lies a tainted pond whose waters suffer from spiritual pollution. Guided by the sapta's perception, the bearer must seek out these corrupted waters to uncover the disturbance and restore harmony to the local water spirits.
sections.title: Disturbance in Westfall

summary: The Water Sapta is a ceremonial draught used to attune one's spiritual sight to the hidden spirits and corruptions of water. Entrusted with this preparation, the bearer is sent to locate tainted pond water within the fields of Westfall to investigate an elemental imbalance.
